newsitem.title: USA: AM International says no new merger pact.
newsitem.headline: AM International says no new merger pact.

text.p: Am International Inc said Monday that its board of directors and the corporation formed by affiliates of Pacholder Associates Inc to acquire AM have not reached agreement amending their proposed emrger deal.
In January, AM said Pacholder sought to have the amount AM shareholders would receive cut to $4.50 from $5 per share.
AM said it is sending a notice of breach of the agreement to the proposed purchaser.

AM's board of directors is considering its alternatives, including sale to a third party, declaration of a substantial dividend, or a share repurchase program available to all shareholders, the graphic arts products company said.
AM also said Monday that it has received a nonbinding expression of interest from another potential buyer for $5 per share, subject to due diligence and receipt of financing.
AM said it cannot predict whether a transaction will result from the expression of interest.
